title: Yogi. Mold of Seal, Indus valley civilization.jpg

description: Male figure in a "yogic" posture resembling Mulabandhasana, surrounded with animals, resonating with the images of the later Hindu god Shiva. Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vastu Sangrahalaya (ex Prince of Wales Museum), Mumbai. India.
